response.justification: Bogdan significantly exceeds the 15-year experience requirement with approximately 20 years of diverse software engineering expertise and demonstrates strong entrepreneurial credentials through founding GISCollective. However, this role specifically emphasizes AI strategy as a core specialization, and his background lacks the Master's/PhD in AI-related fields and demonstrated recognized expertise in building AI-powered products or platforms that are preferred qualifications. While his recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP at re:cinq is encouraging, there is insufficient evidence of the AI thought leadership and strategic advisory expertise expected for a Principal Engineer role focused on AI.
strengths: 20 years of full-stack software engineering across diverse domains (web, mobile, desktop, embedded, infrastructure) with strong technical foundation
Proven entrepreneurial experience as founder of GISCollective, an open-source geo-data platform with real-world adoption by Green Map and other organizations
Demonstrated leadership and mentoring through Staff-level positions, technical workshops, community teaching, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
concerns: Lacks preferred Master's degree or PhD in AI/ML-related fields, which is central to an AI strategy-focused Principal Engineer role
No demonstrated recognized expertise or products/platforms built with AI; recent AI experience appears to be hands-on implementation rather than strategic thought leadership
Career history primarily shows technical execution and implementation rather than strategic advisory partnerships with customers on technology adoption and differentiation

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and strategic vision gap
Exceeds experience requirements with 20-year track record
Entrepreneurial founder background and recent AI infrastructure exposure
